استنطقن (form X)
# اِسْتَنْطَقْنَ (istanṭaqna) /is.tan.tˤaq.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
# اُسْتُنْطِقْنَ (ustunṭiqna) /us.tun.tˤiq.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
# اِسْتَنْطِقْنَ (istanṭiqna) /is.tan.tˤiq.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
